# +state

**In one sentence:** the single shared, mutable `state` object the whole frontend reads and writes, split into one small file per topic.

## Why it exists
The UI has no framework; controllers and views share data by mutating one plain object. Splitting its starting values by area (projects, steps, job, outputs, mock runtime, library) keeps each piece documented with JSDoc types next to its defaults.

## What's inside
| File | What it does |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Merges all slices into the exported `state` object and declares the combined `AppState` type. |
| `projects.js` | Project list, the loaded project payload, active project name, input folder, concept token. |
| `steps.js` | Selected steps, selected substeps per step (no entry = all), collapsed step rows. |
| `jobs.js` | Active `jobId`, last polled `job` snapshot, `runStarting`, and `handledRequestId` (so one pause is not shown twice). |
| `outputs.js` | Output folder path, whether the user overrode it, and whether it exists on disk. |
| `library.js` | Library grid cards, selected card, search text, sort mode (`recent` or `name`). |
| `mock_runtime.js` | Flags for `--mock` runs: whether the active project is the mock one, its name, and the curate coverage branch. |

## How it works
- Each slice exports a plain object of defaults; `index.js` spreads them into one `state`.
- Code imports `state` and changes fields in place, then calls `render()` (from `shell/render.js`) to repaint.

## Who uses it
- App code imports `../+state/index.js` directly: `components/modal.js`, `job/`, `library/`, `project/`, `shell/events.js`.
- Tests reach it through the re-export `core/state.js`.

## Good to know
- The comment in `index.js` says state is "imported everywhere via `core/state.js`", but no app file does that; only tests under `tests/ui/static/` use `core/state.js`.
- Sets and Maps (`selectedSteps`, `selectedSubsteps`) are replaced wholesale on project load rather than mutated.
